statuses.text:
As a 20+ year design engineer, i can say emphatically that AI enables designers to build great PROTOTYPES or small apps. 

When @dhh talks about hand-written code being dead...I believe him. I believe this is mourning engineering as it was. But I don't think hand-written code === engineering. I think it was just how we did it. 

An engineer thinks in systems, and ways that designers don't often think. I don't think coding is dead. I think it's changed. I value so much my engineers and I witness their talent on the daily, PAIRED with AI as well. 

Long live engineering.
